blocks.text: Yassi Pressman is embracing a new chapter in her life as an engaged woman and film producer, saying she feels grateful and at peace following the milestones. In an ambush interview at the grand media conference of her Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) 2026 entry “Little Hope” on Tuesday, Nov. 10, Pressman was asked how life has been since getting engaged. “I’m very, very happy. Very, very grateful. Panatag ang loob. Ang puso, payapa. Couldn’t ask for more,” she said. “I feel like malaking step into maturity po talaga.” However, Pressman clarified that her romantic life doesn’t influence how she chooses […]...
